title: 6th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/6/2024).
Preliminary debate on the Sovereign Development Fund Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to begin debating the government's Sovereign Development Fund Bill.
